description: The file is a C# source code file configuring and building a web API application using ASP.NET Core. It sets up services, middleware, and endpoints for a notes management API, including CORS, OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, and dependency injection for a notes repository.

methods.name: CreateBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new WebApplicationBuilder instance for configuring the web app.

methods.name: ConfigureKestrel
methods.description: Configures the Kestrel web server to listen on port 3001.

methods.name: AddControllers
methods.description: Adds controllers for handling API requests.

methods.name: AddEndpointsApiExplorer
methods.description: Enables API endpoint exploration for Swagger/OpenAPI.

methods.name: AddOpenApiDocument
methods.description: Configures API documentation with OpenAPI/Swagger, setting title, version, and description.

methods.name: AddCors
methods.description: Configures CORS policy to allow all origins, methods, and headers.

methods.name: AddSingleton
methods.description: Registers the INotesRepository service as a singleton with an in-memory implementation.

methods.name: UseCors
methods.description: Enables the previously configured CORS policy.

methods.name: UseSwaggerUi
methods.description: Enables Swagger UI for API documentation.

methods.name: MapControllers
methods.description: Maps controller routes for handling API requests.

methods.name: MapGet
